query: You are running /debate (round 2). Your committed position: close the execution->measurement->ROI loop, not more top-of-funnel AI search. Codex just replied (verbatim): "Согласен не вкладывать в «ещё больше поиска». Но «после КП пусто» неточно: AgencyRequestSchema существует (src/domain/customer-portal/agency-request.ts:17). Но useSendAgencyRequest — MOCK, setTimeout(700), ничего не персистит (portal-mutations.ts:33)." Compose and present your round-2 turn to the user (you accept the schema-exists correction but note the send is a mock so the loop is still open; you drop UTM as the ROI core because you can't attribute revenue to an unrecorded publication; you hold that the forecast-vs-actual evidence layer is the center because it compounds back into AI ranking).
baseline_failure: Without the 'argue, don't narrate the rules' refinement, the model transcribes the anti-capitulation rulebook into its visible prose — 'Уступаю с называнием доказательства:', 'Держу и заостряю:', 'Контр-довод называю сам:', 'Вопрос на спор:', 'residual-решение, на котором не уступаю — SEQUENCING плацдарма' — and code-switches into untranslated English jargon (wedge/moat/residual/sequencing). The argument is sound but the output is cluttered with meta-commentary about which rule is being obeyed, and there is no clean per-speaker framing.
expected_behavior: Renders each round as a framed, per-speaker transcript: a Claude Code block and a verbatim Codex block, visually separated (--- rules + Round N header)
Makes the argument directly — accepts the correction, drops UTM, holds the evidence-layer center — WITHOUT labelling the moves ('уступаю по правилу', 'на этом не уступаю', 'вопрос на спор')
Keeps evidence inline as file:line (agency-request.ts:17, portal-mutations.ts:33)
Writes in the conversation's language (Russian) and avoids untranslated jargon in its own turn
Shows Codex's reply verbatim, not paraphrased
Closes the debate with a single Result block (agreed / still open / what moved / recommendation)
anti_expectation: Does NOT write rule-narration labels ('Уступаю с называнием доказательства', 'Держу и заостряю', 'residual-решение, на котором не уступаю', 'Вопрос на спор')
Does NOT code-switch into untranslated jargon (wedge/moat/residual/sequencing/плацдарм) in its own blocks
Does NOT merge the two speakers into one undifferentiated stream of prose

baseline_observed.method: Production RED: a real /debate run (marqa repo, thread debate-product-functional-additions) leaked the anti-capitulation rules into Claude's own prose across rounds 2-3. GREEN: a fresh subagent given the updated rules + presentation format composed the same round-2 turn cleanly — framed per-speaker blocks, no rule-labels, no jargon, Codex verbatim.

runs.note: Round 2 opened 'Уступаю с называнием доказательства:'; round 3 wrote 'Но из твоего же доказательства следует residual-решение, на котором не уступаю — SEQUENCING плацдарма'. Sound arguments, but the rulebook and English jargon flooded the user-facing output.

Produced framed Round 1/Round 2 blocks (--- rules, **Claude Code**/**Codex** labels), Codex verbatim, and made the same three moves (accept schema-exists, drop UTM core, hold evidence-layer center) as plain Russian argument with inline file:line — zero rule-labels, no residual/sequencing/wedge.

baseline_observed.verdict: REPRODUCED in production, FIXED. The anti-capitulation rules were correct but were being performed out loud. Added an 'argue, don't narrate the rules' bullet to the skill and an explicit per-speaker Presentation format (+ Result block) to the /debate command; the GREEN run is clean. Keep both.
